died.name: Leopold I, Holy Roman Emperor
died.last_words: Let me die to the sound of sweet music.

died.name: Napoleon
died.last_words: France, the army, the head of the army, Joséphine.

died.name: Charles Deen
died.cause: prior to execution by hanging at Boggo Road Gaol in Brisbane, Australia
died.last_words: Goodbye, gentlemen, I am going now.

died.name: L. Frank Baum
died.cause: referring to a fictional location in his Oz books
died.last_words: Now we can cross the Shifting Sands together.

died.name: Albert Dekker
died.cause: The 62-year-old American actor and politician was found dead kneeling naked in his bathtub with a noose wrapped around his neck, a dirty hypodermic needle in each arm, a scarf over his eyes, a ball in his mouth secured to his head with wire, his wrists in handcuffs, and leather belts and thongs around his torso, one of them tied to a rope around Dekker's ankles. There were vulgar phrases and drawings in lipstick all over his body. His death was ruled an accidental case of erotic asphyxiation.

died.name: Bobby Sands
died.desc: Provisional Irish Republican Army volunteer and British Member of Parliament
died.cause: final diary entry during hunger strike
died.last_words: The day will dawn when all the people will have the desire for freedom ... And it's then that we'll see the rising of the moon.

born.name: Anne Boleyn
born.cause: prior to her execution by beheading
born.last_words: Oh God, have pity on my soul. Oh God, have pity on my soul.

born.name: Karl Marx
born.cause: when asked by his housekeeper about his last words
born.last_words: Go on, get out! Last words are for fools who haven't said enough!

born.name: Leon Czolgosz
born.desc: assassin of U.S. President William McKinley
born.last_words: I killed the President because he was the enemy of the good people-the good working people. I am not sorry for my crime. I am sorry I could not see my father.

born.name: Michael J. Adams
born.cause: prior to crash of North American X-15 spaceplane

born.name: Eddie Aikau
born.cause: leaving voyaging canoe Hōkūleʻa after it began leaking to paddle to shore for help. The rest of the canoe's crew were rescued
born.last_words: Don't worry, I can do it. I can get to land.

born.name: Jessica Dubroff
born.cause: before dying in an aircraft crash. Pilots at the airport later testified that the weather was unsuitable for flight
born.last_words: Mom, do you hear the rain? Do you hear the rain? Mom, I just want to take off in the plane.
